system.description:
The mage perceives the spirit world and thins or opens a passage through the Gauntlet between the material and the Umbra. Rank 1 senses spirits; rank 3 reaches across or steps through the barrier. In play this lets the caster peer into, communicate with, or step sideways into the spirit realm.

Dice Pool: Perception + Awareness (+1 die as a rote)

Adapted to M5 from M20 Spirit 3; mechanics paraphrased.
